states.means: A required fact is recorded as filled, together with the turn it was heard in.
states.costs: A false collected is silent for the rest of the conversation. The fact is closed, so nothing will ask for it again and nothing downstream will know it was guessed.

states.means: Named explicitly on every turn. Never a blank cell and never a zero.
states.costs: Asking again for something already given, which is the most common reason a person abandons an intake flow part-way through.

states.means: A value was captured and the dialogue state says it is not that value.
states.costs: The most, because the checklist reads as full. A mis-recorded recipient moves money to a name nobody confirmed.

states.means: Not a fact state - the kit's actual output: ask again, or stop.
states.costs: Stopping early hands a downstream process a record it believes is complete. Never stopping is cheaper and visible, which is exactly why the expensive failure is the one that needs its own number.
